_note: ElevenLabs 효과음 프롬프트. node tools/sfx/generate.mjs [이름...] 로 다시 만든다. 결과는 assets/audio/sfx/<이름>.mp3 / lowpass·highpass(Hz): 고음·저음(마이크 파열음)을 깎는다 / peak(dB): 최고 크기(기본 -3)

tap-1.text: a single quick soft paper rustle, flicking the corner of one book page, very short, dry, close microphone, no music

tap-2.text: one light crisp paper flick, a thin sheet brushed by a fingertip, very short, dry, no music

tap-3.text: one crisp page of a book turned quickly by hand, short paper swish, close microphone, no music

correct.text: a single crisp finger snap, short bright click, dry, close microphone, no reverb, no music

wrong.text: a heavy thick hardcover book falling and landing flat on a wooden table, loud deep dull thud, a few pages flapping after, close microphone, no music

clash.text: two thick hardcover books slammed against each other, sharp hollow wooden clack with paper flutter, no music

hit.text: a thick hardcover book striking a wooden table hard, punchy hollow wooden thump, short, no music

stagger.text: a tall stack of books wobbling on a wooden cart, old wood creaking, loose papers sliding and scattering, no music

book.text: many book pages fluttering quickly in a gust, then a hardcover book softly closing, airy library room tone, no music
